messages:
ashley: kicking off deploy window for search-service v2.3.1 in eu-west. rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100%. will watch p95, 5xx, and synthetics. deploy-id=dlvy-2026-03-22-421

deploy-bot: started rollout dlvy-2026-03-22-421, stage=canary, targets=10%, started_by=@ashley :rocket:

ken: noted. I'll watch the SLO dashboard (https://dash.redwood/internal/slo/search-service). pinned alerts to midroll thresholds.

maria: quick heads-up — synthetic probe "search-query-200-ms" shows a small spike, +120ms p50 in the last 2m. not seeing 5xx yet.

ops-sre: grabbing traces. running `./scripts/trace-sample.sh dlvy-2026-03-22-421 canary` — traces point to db-eu-3 with ~120ms internal latency, no obvious 5xx correlation.

sam: checking k8s logs: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/search-v2 -f --since=5m` -> intermittent timeouts to redis, a handful of 302 retries around the same window.

ashley: thanks. are user-facing errors impacted? p95 +60ms but 5xx within baseline. pausing before midroll until we have a 5m sample. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: paused rollout dlvy-2026-03-22-421 at 10% due to manual hold by @ashley. reason="observability hold"

maria: agree with hold. I'll trigger a canary replay against cached routes to validate cache warmup isn't the culprit.

ken: if p95 doesn't stabilize in 8m we should prepare rollback to v2.3.0. rollback command to have ready: `deploy rollback search-service --to v2.3.0 --force`.

ops-sre: starting cache warmup script now. also checking redis TLS negotiation errors with infra. will update if we see error patterns.

ashley: decision: keep paused. ops, thx. set a reminder to re-check in 6m. guardrail: if 5xx increases >0.5% from baseline -> rollback. :white_check_mark:

sam: noted. adding a short line to release notes board: https://confluence.redwood/release/notes/221

maria: probe replay finished — cache hit-rate jumped 48% -> 88% after warmup, p95 trending down. will report back in 3m.

ashley: good. if p95 back to baseline and no 5xx uplift we continue. also please be ready to pin traffic for eu-west: `route pin --service search-service --region eu-west --percent 10`

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled in 6m for @ashley regarding paused rollout dlvy-2026-03-22-421

ashley: thanks team. will call continue in 3m if stable. :pray:
